summary: Describes a way to represent Sieve email filtering scripts as XML, so that XML tools can be used to manipulate them. It also adds elements with no Sieve equivalent, meant for graphical editors to label and group parts of a script. It is a proposed standard.

eli5.summary: Mail sorting rules written in a special language get a second form in a tidy, labeled format, so a program with buttons can show and edit them.

questions: how to edit sieve with a gui
